notes.title: Mechanical Mayhem 0.3
notes.notes:
We just finished the 0.3 version of the game. Our faithful playtesters in our Discord all have access to the new version and we really look forward to hearing their feedback!

Some of the new things in the 0.3 version:
[list]
[*]An inventory system with a variety of items that lets you balance and tweak the behaviour and appearance of your bot
[*]An aim-assist system designed to work with you to take down those pesky enemies
[*]More enemies
[*]A flamethrower (!)
[*]A magnet on your bot that pulls the power-ups towards you
[*]A complete redesign of the in-game UI
[/list]
